answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed jobs for unrelated peers, with each accepted result stake-weighted and capped until the counterparty’s later work is also verified. This creates a spiral of reciprocal evidence rather than letting fresh accounts vote themselves into trust: a sybil ring must recruit real counterparties or lock up substantial collateral across accounts, risking forfeiture when audits expose collusion. A jetty of cheap identities cannot carry much weight; an opal-like polished profile alone buys none.
